newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 balance of payments surplus $8.665 bln.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 balance of payments surplus $8.665 bln.

text.p: Brazil's 1996 balance of payments surplus was $8.665 billion, the Central Bank said Friday.
Brazil's 1996 capital account totalled $33.012 billion, while the current account deficit was $24.347 billion, it said.
Brazil's 1995 balance of payments surplus was $12.919 billion. The capital account surplus was $30.891 billion, and the current account deficit was $17.972 billion.
The central bank said Brazil's January current account deficit totalled $1.907 billion. It said this represented a "significant improvement" over the $4.6 billion deficit posted in December.
Foreign direct investment in January totalled $800 million, against $515 million in January 1996, it said. Foreign direct investment for 1996 was $9.442 billion, it said.
